pmtilesV3.sectionLayout: non-header sections may be relocated; validate absolute section ranges, not fixed section order

entries.offset: tile entries relative to tile-data section; leaf entries relative to leaf-directory section
entries.runLength: 0 means leaf pointer; positive means addressed tile run
entries.tileId: cumulative Hilbert position across zoom pyramids
entries.offsetEncoding: encoded 0 at index>0 means previous offset+length; otherwise encoded value-1

pmtilesV3.clustered: first tile offset0; later new contents contiguous, reused contents reference lesser prior offsets
pmtilesV3.metadata: UTF-8 JSON object; MVT requires vector_layers

nativeCli.showFormats: run each JSON option separately; header-json is a selected header view
nativeCli.tileOutput: stored compressed tile bytes; absent tile can return empty stdout without failure
nativeCli.verifyScope: structure/header statistics, excluding individual tile-content validation

verifyLimitations.finding: tile-data range overrun logs Invalid without returning error
cluster-order branch checks !Contains after adding the same offset; the branch is unreachable

extractRules.region: GeoJSON Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry, Feature or FeatureCollection; use exact native parser
extractRules.zoomBounds: inclusive; defaults are clamped to input header
extractRules.output: os.Create truncates destination; use a new owned staging path and install only after verification
extractRules.metadata: original metadata bytes copied into output
extractRules.content: selects full source tiles intersecting AOI, preserving their encoded contents

martin.sourceMode: named sources snapshot at startup; restart the owned process for each selected immutable release

readiness.expected: tiles.toner under the exact reviewed source ID
TileJSON for selected archive, with declared tile URLs/zoom bounds/attribution
actual tile content at a selected known-present coordinate

martin.conversion: set convert_to_mlt and convert_to_mvt to disabled when release expects original archive tile encoding

browser.availability: mapLibreMap becomes available only after attachment to a visible map with a target; layer emits load
browser.dispose: removing/disposal tears down original MapLibre map

pmtilesJs.directoryResult: Entry[] with tileId, offset, length, runLength

entry.tile: runLength > 0: tileIdToZxy(entry.tileId) selects the first tile in the addressed run
entry.leaf: runLength === 0: read header.leafDirectoryOffset + entry.offset, entry.length, with the same cache/source/header

pmtilesJs.rangeValidation: Validate selected relative directory/tile ranges against their original header sections; preserve the product's byte/entry limits and reject directory cycles.
pmtilesJs.confirm: await archive.getZxy(z,x,y,signal) must return a nonempty RangeResponse.data for readiness
pmtilesJs.tileOutput: decompressed tile bytes, unlike the Go tile CLI's stored compressed bytes
